meta.name: service-mesh-observability
meta.description: Implement comprehensive observability for service meshes including distributed tracing, metrics, and visualization. Use when setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency issues, or implementing SLOs for service communication.

copy.tagline: 监控服务网格的分布式追踪与指标,快速定位延迟问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在运行微服务架构,想看清服务间的调用链和延迟瓶颈。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor service mesh traces and metrics to fix latency issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run microservices and need clear visibility into service-to-service latency.

howto.what: Claude 会按技能指南,协助你为服务网格搭建可观测性体系:配置分布式追踪、采集网格指标与日志,并设置告警和可视化仪表板。
howto.when: 当你要求设置服务网格监控、排查服务间延迟问题,或为服务通信制定 SLO 时触发。

say.text: 帮我为 Istio 服务网格配置分布式追踪
say.note: Claude 会给出追踪接入和链路配置方法。

say.text: 服务之间延迟很高,帮我定位瓶颈
say.note: Claude 会按延迟排查流程引导你分析。

say.text: 为我的服务通信设置 SLO 并加告警
say.note: 它会提供 SLO 指标定义和告警阈值参考。

howto.what_en: Claude follows the skill guide to help you build observability for a service mesh: configure distributed tracing, collect mesh metrics and logs, and set up alerts and visualization dashboards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up service mesh monitoring, debug inter-service latency issues, or define SLOs for service communication.

say_en.text: Help me configure distributed tracing for an Istio service mesh.
say_en.note: Claude will provide tracing integration and chain setup steps.

say_en.text: Services are slow; help me find the latency bottleneck.
say_en.note: It will guide you through latency troubleshooting.

say_en.text: Set up SLOs with alerts for my service communication.
say_en.note: It will suggest SLO metrics and alert thresholds.
